# Aerocool Ukraine

> Official Aerocool Ukraine website for gaming, office, computer and home office chairs, with Ukrainian and Russian product, article, FAQ and contact pages.

This file gives AI agents a concise map of the public site. Use visible page content, JSON-LD, canonical URLs, hreflang links and sitemap files as the source of truth for product facts, availability, pricing, delivery, warranty and service terms.

## Primary Pages

- [Homepage](https://aerocool.ua/): Ukrainian main page for Aerocool Ukraine.
- [Products](https://aerocool.ua/products/): Ukrainian catalog hub for Aerocool chair series and product variants.
- [FAQ](https://aerocool.ua/faq/): Purchase, delivery, warranty, return and service answers.
- [Contact](https://aerocool.ua/contact/): Official contact page for product selection, purchase and service questions.
- [About Aerocool Ukraine](https://aerocool.ua/about/): Brand, local catalog and support context.

## Product Series

- [SKY series](https://aerocool.ua/products/sky/): SKY Light and SKY 360 chair series page.
- [WING series](https://aerocool.ua/products/wing/): WING chair series page.
- [XTAL series](https://aerocool.ua/products/xtal/): XTAL chair series page.

## Editorial Guides
